name: Aeon Kyushu Co., Ltd.
summary: Aeon Kyushu Co., Ltd., a retail company, engages in the management of various stores in Japan. The company operates supermarkets; stores that provide lifestyle products; shops that offer clothing, food, home, and leisure products; home stores that provide various products and a range of services, such as DIY, pet, and gardening supplies; and bicycle specialty shops that offer bicycle parts and apparel items, as well as business development services. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan. Aeon Kyushu Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Aeon Co., Ltd.
